bullets: • Name the CSS property and its exact before/after values.
• Specify the selector receiving the change without implementation detail.
• Assert unchanged properties remain unmodified in that selector.
• Describe the observable visual outcome users will see.
• Write assertions as testable facts, not procedural steps.
• Use consistent notation for all color and numeric values.
• Verify computed styles match assertions; reject scope creep.
• Avoid build processes, tooling requirements, and file structure specifics.
